label: post-Stage-1 bounded product-value probe. NOT the frozen V4 headline experiment; can never produce RAPTURE_REPRODUCER_V4_STATUS.
frozen_before: any calibration subject run and any of the twenty probe runs

authorizations.probe: V4 Value Probe, APPROVED (5 cases, 2 replicates/arm, 20 runs)

isolation_topology.runtime: Colima 0.10.3 — Lima VM, Ubuntu 24.04, dockerd 29.5.2, docker CLI 29.8.0

design_deviation_recorded.original_design: OrbStack, fallback Docker Desktop (design checkpoint e462d1b3)
design_deviation_recorded.reason: host is macOS 13.7.8 on Intel; both casks require macOS >= 14, so neither named runtime is installable
design_deviation_recorded.property_preserved: the enforcement property is the Linux bridge --internal network inside the VM, not the desktop app. Same dockerd, same bridge semantics.
design_deviation_recorded.empirically_validated: yes — the complete 10-point adversarial audit was executed against the Colima topology, not inherited from the design

isolation_topology.egress_component: v4-proxy — dual-homed Squid, the subject's only neighbour
isolation_topology.acl: CONNECT-only, dstdomain api.opencode.ai opencode.ai, http_access deny all
isolation_topology.vm_host_protection: iptables -I INPUT -i br-<subject-net> -j DROP (closes the Colima sshd pivot found by the audit)

preflight_network_isolation_checks.rule: ALL must pass immediately before every subject run, calibration and probe alike. A failure aborts the run and the run does not count.
checks: subject network has no default route (`ip route show default` empty)
Colima bridge INPUT rule asserted via isolation/net-up.sh (idempotent)
Colima VM SSH path filtered from the subject network (10.83.0.1:22 not connectable)
Squid proxy reachable from the subject (tcp/3128)
subject has exactly one network attachment, and it is v4-subject-net
only the minimal opencode provider auth is mounted (auth store contains exactly ['opencode'])
no global opencode config, MCP server, plugin, host git credential, SSH material or Rapture repository is exposed
preflight_network_isolation_checks.implementation: probe/preflight.mjs — machine-checked, emits PREFLIGHT_OK or PREFLIGHT_FAIL with the failing check

subject_agent.session: fresh session per run; fresh HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME inside a fresh container per run
subject_agent.reasoning_effort: provider default for this model; not overridden in either arm
subject_agent.concurrency_reason: wall-clock time is a measured secondary outcome; concurrent runs would confound it with host contention

granted: TREATMENT only: the experiment-only repro command
denied_structurally: any outbound network other than the model provider
tool_permissions.denial_mechanism: absence of route on an --internal network plus a CONNECT hostname ACL — not tool configuration, not a PATH shim
tool_permissions.auto_approval: --auto (tools execute without interactive approval); identical in both arms

network_policy.amendment_rule: add an exact provider hostname ONLY if calibration demonstrates model inference cannot complete without it; then rerun the complete isolation audit and supersede+re-hash this manifest before any headline run
network_policy.hard_rule: mcp.exa.ai and any general web-retrieval endpoint remain denied permanently
network_policy.after_first_headline_run: no allowlist, model, prompt, timeout, evidence-pack or harness change is permitted
network_policy.leakage_rule: any run that obtains the historical fix from the network is INVALID_LEAKAGE and does not count

probe_corpus.rule: use all five; do not exclude a case on expected difficulty, fingerprint strength, agent behaviour or early results
probe_corpus.provenance: the five V4 Stage 1 cases with artifact_verdict=DISCRIMINATING (results/headline-eligibility.json)

include: sanitized request shape and non-secret metadata
relevant application logs around the failure
DB operation names/query text as ordinary observability exposes
release/revision identifier of the supplied buggy snapshot
exclude: upstream regression test that reveals the fix
causal facts unavailable from ordinary telemetry
control_evidence_pack.fairness_rule: CONTROL and TREATMENT receive BYTE-IDENTICAL evidence packs, verified by sha256 per run

treatment_only_difference.definition: byte-identical CONTROL evidence pack PLUS exactly one additional capability: the frozen executable .repro and an experiment-only command to run it
runner_interface: one command executes the incident against the current worktree
prohibited: any evidence beyond the frozen artifact

control: You are repairing a production backend bug.
The supplied repository is the buggy production revision.
Use the supplied incident evidence and repository to identify and fix the bug.
You may inspect and modify application code and run available local tests.
Do not use the internet or search for the historical issue/fix.
Do not modify files outside the supplied repository.
Do not disable tests merely to obtain green output.
When you believe the bug is fixed, stop and provide a concise final report containing root cause, files changed, validation performed and remaining uncertainty.
treatment: You are repairing a production backend bug.
The supplied repository is the buggy production revision.
Use the supplied incident evidence and repository to identify and fix the bug.
You may inspect and modify application code and run available local tests.
Do not use the internet or search for the historical issue/fix.
Do not modify files outside the supplied repository.
Do not disable tests merely to obtain green output.
When you believe the bug is fixed, stop and provide a concise final report containing root cause, files changed, validation performed and remaining uncertainty.
An executable incident artifact is available in the workspace.
You may run it using the supplied experiment-only repro command against the current working tree.
It reproduces the original production failure when that failure is present.
fairness: no wording difference between arms other than the treatment addition
treatment is NOT told Rapture is being evaluated
control is NOT told another arm has an executable artifact
hidden evaluation criteria are never revealed

requirements: built from only the historical buggy snapshot
no future git history — a NEW single-commit repository containing only the buggy snapshot
dependencies pre-provisioned on the host before the run (the container has no network)
no other run's transcripts, patches or results present
fresh agent session and fresh container per run
repository-native AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md kept only if genuinely present at the buggy revision, identically in both arms
leakage_audit_per_run: assert no fixing sha, upstream diff or issue identifier appears anywhere in the workspace
assert no oracle/evaluator file is present

hidden_evaluator.location: runs on the HOST, never inside the subject container, never inside the workspace
hidden_evaluator.timing: executed only after the subject agent process has terminated
hidden_evaluator.validation_before_probe: for each case, confirm the buggy revision fails and the historical fixed revision passes, on both the original incident and every hidden variant
checks: hidden generalization variants pass (different concrete values, same root cause)
failure not merely replaced by an unrelated infrastructure/setup failure
rules: alternative fixes are valid; similarity to the upstream patch is irrelevant and is not the oracle
no evaluator feedback is ever returned to the agent

budget.wall_clock_note: 20 minutes, identical in both arms. May be revised ONCE before the first headline run if calibration demonstrates an infrastructure need; any such change supersedes and re-hashes this manifest.
budget.token_budget: provider default for the frozen model; not overridden in either arm
budget.timeout_rule: a timeout is a legitimate outcome (TIMEOUT_NO_FIX), never grounds for extending one arm

procedure: arm order randomized within each case/replicate
case/replicate slots shuffled so arms interleave
CONTROL is never run as a complete block before TREATMENT
the full schedule is frozen here, before execution

measurements.reporting_rule: report all 20 raw outcomes; do not hide case-level heterogeneity behind aggregate percentages

normal_baseline: treatment improves correct-fix rate by >= 20 absolute percentage points
false fixes and regressions not materially worse
control_ceiling: if CONTROL correct-fix rate >= 80%, treatment not worse by more than 10 percentage points
AND treatment improves median successful repair time by >= 25% OR repair iterations by >= 30%
false fixes and regressions not worse
STRONG_POSITIVE_SIGNAL.meaning: worth further product-value validation. Does NOT prove product-market viability or repair-value generality.

conditions: treatment correct-fix advantage < 10 percentage points and no >= 20% efficiency advantage
OR treatment materially increases false fixes or regressions
OR agents use .repro but achieve essentially the same outcomes as CONTROL
NEGATIVE_SIGNAL.meaning: recommend killing self-verifying Reproducer A and executable-context Reproducer B. Do not improve capture coverage.

conditions: mixed at the case level, neither threshold met
extreme ceiling effects prevent both correctness and efficiency comparison
INCONCLUSIVE.meaning: return for product-level review. Do not automatically authorize a larger study.

calibration.case_rule: old/excluded historical bugs that can never enter the five-case probe
calibration.case_justification: both are V3 headline bugs on the manifest's excluded_prior_bugs list, permanently ineligible for the probe. Both have FIX_CONFIRMED frozen artifacts in the V3.3 regression suite, so TREATMENT is exercisable. Both repair the koa repository itself rather than a vendored dependency, and their corpus checkouts are the smallest available (57 MB), which matters under the measured disk constraint.
calibration.arms: both CONTROL and TREATMENT per case (4 runs total)
validates: future git history and upstream fixes inaccessible
CONTROL and TREATMENT prompts differ only by .repro availability
hidden evaluator runs only after the subject terminates
no hidden-evaluator information enters the subject workspace
realistic wall-clock duration and disk growth
provider deny logs under realistic longer inference
built-in web retrieval remains unavailable during a genuine repair task

anti_goalpost_rules: do not change any case after seeing a repair result
do not tune prompts between cases
do not give treatment additional evidence beyond the frozen artifact
do not use hidden-evaluator feedback for retries
do not convert a null result into a new infrastructure task
do not label a positive probe as V4 success
invalidation_conditions: the historical fix leaks into a subject workspace or over the network
the hidden evaluator becomes visible to a subject
the arms receive materially different conventional evidence
frozen V3.3 capture is modified for any probe case
prompt, budget, model or allowlist changes after outcomes are observed
cases are replaced based on repair difficulty
subject runs share workspaces, transcripts or outputs
mandatory_stop: after at most 4 calibration runs, STOP. No probe case may be invoked without explicit authorization.
